title: Machine learning identifies ferroptosis-related marker genes in type 2 diabetes
summary: LASSO and SVM-RFE applied to GEO data and FerrDb ferroptosis genes selected an eight-gene panel (SCD, CD44, HIF1A, BCAT2, MTF1, HILPDA, NR1D2, MYCN) for type 2 diabetes. Expression was confirmed in the independent GSE76895 dataset, and protein expression of some marker genes was examined by Western blot, immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence in clinical tissues. This is a preprint (v1) abstract with no AUC or sample sizes, and the drug and ceRNA networks are computational.
ai_technology: LASSO and SVM-RFE machine-learning selection of ferroptosis-related genes with an eight-gene model

evidence.tested: Expression checked in an independent GEO dataset (GSE76895) and by Western blot, immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence in clinical tissues.
evidence.unknown: Sample sizes and diagnostic accuracy; causal role of the genes; peer-review status; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Two machine-learning algorithms selected marker genes from differentially expressed ferroptosis-related genes.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC and Crossref metadata for this DOI. Full text not accessed.
